name: planning-with-files
description: Claude Code fork of planning-with-files (Manus-style persistent planning files). Hooks run from hooks/hooks.json (reliable, avoids skill-frontmatter bug #17688) and add local customizations: per-session plan binding, auto-bind on init-session, 临时任务 suppression, and .hooks_mode gating. Dir-based .planning/<id>/ plans with per-session read anchoring (anti cross-plan read). v2.43.0-claude.5 adds a HARD guard: PreToolUse denies a bare resolve-plan-dir.sh run (no PLAN_ID → wrong .active_plan fallback; override with PWF_ALLOW_BARE_RESOLVE=1), and Stop/PostToolUse reminders now name resolved canonical paths. v2.43.0-claude.6 adds an optional hook debug mode (PWF_HOOK_DEBUG=on or .planning/.hooks_debug; default OFF) that logs each hook's decision to .planning/debug/hook-events.jsonl and a one-line systemMessage — on top of the official attestation, PreCompact, and security framing.
